## Accepted partial result and exact limit

Add the complete substantive authored report and independent mathematical audit for 30006403 / OWR-14299518-027. Status remains **UNRESOLVED, approach 1 of 5**.

For every field, the report proves the sparse-basis bound z≥max{0,ceil(n−sqrt(rE))} and, for integers k>r≥1, the oversampling bound z/n≥[(k−r)/(2k−r)]·(1−E/n²)^k, together with the stronger quadratic inequality. The row and column sets are independent; a zero square need not be principal.

For E≤εn² and 0<ε<1/2, the resulting estimate is z≥ceil(n exp(−6 max{sqrt(εr),εr})). It establishes the conjectured square-root form with C=6 for εr≤1 and C=2 for εr≤1/4. For unbounded εr, the proved exponent remains linear rather than square root. The full arbitrary-real conjecture is not resolved.

The F₂ dot-product example is only a field-independent-method obstruction. Its rank over F₂ is d, while the same array has real rank 2^d−1; it is not a real-rank counterexample. Exact rank-one and real set-intersection-family proofs are retained, along with all limitations on support, mean, entrywise squaring and support-matrix rank reductions.

## Attribution and retained mathematics

[Singer–Sudan](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.09592), Section 3 / Theorem 1.7, is credited for the prior probabilistic dimension-drop method. This report is an elementary adaptation/refinement, with no novelty or best-known-real-bound claim. [HMST](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.13510) supplies Conjecture 1.8 and a prior small-density endpoint. The [OWR source](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/52246), printed p. 2309, states Conjecture 5. HMST's nonnegative-entry/mean-based body theorem and its logarithmic rank term remain distinct from the arbitrary-real support-density target.

Every substantive authored mathematical block and independent mathematical and attribution Sections 2–5 are retained verbatim. Section 1 differs only by removal of one trailing space. Computational descriptions and obsolete artifact/workflow bindings are omitted. The audit's inline-math delimiters were repaired without mathematical change before this edition. The scoped acceptance binds the actual distributed editions. Seven public PDF identities and original retrieval/inspection history are retained without distributing source documents or derived text/images.

AI-assisted and unrefereed. No external human peer review, proof-assistant certification, exhaustive present-day literature status or original-discovery claim is asserted.

## Repository boundary

Exactly eight files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30006403/`. No QUEUE.md, existing attempt, unrelated record or historical turn count changes. Edition preparation adds no substantive proof-search approach and does not reconstruct or reset accounting.

The packet contains authored proof, mathematical audit, scoped acceptance and public bibliographic verification metadata only. Source bodies, datasets, private material, scripts, fixtures, computation outputs and logs, and excluded-artifact identities are omitted. No excluded artifact is converted to replacement prose. No merge, release, DOI deposit or external outreach is part of this change.

## Preparation checks

Exact editorial differences and byte-preserved mathematical blocks were checked. Public PDF identities, UTF-8 and JSON, relative links, manifest, exact allowlist and excluded-material scan passed. The additive patch passed strict-whitespace clean temporary replay with exact paths and bytes. The freshly read base Git tree chain was independently rehashed; unrelated entries, including the QUEUE blob, are preserved. These are packaging checks, not additional mathematical certification; no CI pass is claimed. Exact-head remote readback remains separate.
